messages:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — I have a dentist appointment and will be completely offline for ~2h starting soon. I'm currently listed as primary for the embeds-prod rota. We just saw a spike of pagers on embeds (latency + error-rate). If someone can swap primary with me for the next 2 hours that would be great. Runbook link: <https://runbooks.redwood.com/embeds/pg-drain|embeds runbook> . I can try to hand off now but will lose signal at EOD local.
Maria Patel: I can take primary for the window, +1 to a swap. tagging Jamal in case we want warm shadowing: @Jamal Ortiz
Jamal Ortiz: I can be warm-shadow for the next 90m. If things stay quiet I can pick up full primary at +30m. Will ack pager. What’s the current alert routing? any recent change to pd policies?
Alex Kim: Current routing is pd policy `embeds-prod-primary` -> primary escalation. No config changes today. Last deploy was earlier (db pool fix) but looks unrelated. Quick telemetry: 5xx rate spiked to 3.2% and p50 latency jumped to 420ms over last 3m.
IncBot: :rotating_light: Incident summary (auto): service=embeds, severity=SEV2, pages=8 in last 10m, impacted_customers=3, alerting_rule=embeds_high_5xx. Refer to runbook.
Lee Chen: If Maria is primary, I'll stand up a temporary routing override to send new pages to her and Jamal only. I can run the command now — will need someone's ack to proceed.
Maria Patel: go for it Lee. I'll be online and watching. Jamal — once Lee flips routing please confirm you’re receiving test page (I’ll trigger a low-impact test alert).
Lee Chen: Running routing change now:
```
# switch PD primary to Maria and add Jamal as secondary shadow
pdctl rotate --service embeds-prod --from alex.kim --to maria.patel --add-shadow jamal.ortiz --note "temporary swap, alex OOO for 2h"
```
Lee Chen: pdctl returned OK. PagerDuty: incidents routed to maria.patel and jamal.ortiz. Also set mute window on alex.kim to avoid noise. :white_check_mark:
Jamal Ortiz: got test page at 1m. Confirmed. I can also take escalations if Maria needs help. Will monitor error traces.
Maria Patel: Received test page, acked. Thanks Lee. Quick plan: 1) Maria primary 2) Jamal warm shadow 3) Lee on routing+ops 4) Alex returns to primary after 2h or earlier if he signals. If we see error rate >5% escalate to SRE lead.
Alex Kim: Thanks team — appreciate the cover. One small note: if latency persists, the runbook suggests toggling prefix caching (step 3) before scaling replicas. See snippet:
```
# runbook snippet: enable prefix caching
kubectl -n embeds exec -it svc/embeds-api -- /bin/sh -c "echo 'enable_cache=1' > /etc/embeds/config && kill -HUP 1"
```
Maria Patel: Noted. We’ll try cache toggle first. Lee, can you pre-authorize a quick scale to +2 pods in case cache doesn't help? I’ll coordinate if we need it.
Lee Chen: Pre-authorized autoscale bump: `kubectl scale deployment embeds-api --replicas=+2` allowed for oncall. I’ll stand by to run if Maria requests. Also added a small dashboard panel for 5xx rows and tail of logs in case we need to triage fast.
IncBot: :information_source: Post-action note: routing rotated by Lee Chen at T+1m. Test alert acknowledged by Jamal Ortiz and Maria Patel. Monitoring hook added.
Maria Patel: I'll keep thread updates. Current action: toggled prefix cache (per runbook), monitoring next 3 minutes for 5xx drop. If no improvement, request scale.
Jamal Ortiz: Observing traces — most errors look like timeout to embeds-store connection. If cache toggle is no-op, suggest we open a quick prod-store ticket and escalate to infra.
Maria Patel: Cache toggle gave a small improvement: 5xx dropped to 1.4% after ~90s, p50 latency down to 260ms. Looks stable for now. I'll keep primary on until Alex returns. Jamal will maintain warm shadow for the next hour.
Alex Kim: Thanks all. I’ll update calendar and let OpsOncall know I’m out for 2h. If anything spikes >4% please ping me directly (SMS). Back soon.
OpsOncall: Noted and recorded: temporary primary swap from Alex Kim -> Maria Patel, shadow Jamal Ortiz, routing change applied by Lee Chen. Logged handoff in #oncall-shifts with incident refs. :ledger:
Maria Patel: Closing notes: left a short checklist in the runbook entry about the cache toggle outcome, added logs link, and marked Alex as muted. If anything else crops up I’ll post here. :thumbsup:
Alex Kim: Recovered signal earlier than expected; I'm back now. Maria — do you want to hand back or should we keep you primary until the end of your shift?
Maria Patel: If you're back and able, you can resume primary. I'll hand back now. Lee — can you flip routing back to Alex?
Lee Chen: Doing the flip back now:
```
pdctl rotate --service embeds-prod --from maria.patel --to alex.kim --remove-shadow jamal.ortiz --note "handback after cache fix"
```
Lee Chen: Done. PagerDuty now routes to alex.kim as primary. Jamal remains unassigned.
Alex Kim: Confirmed I received a low-volume test and I'm seeing normal metrics. Thanks team for quick cover and smooth handoff. Closing thread.
_meta: generated for dataset: on-call handoff/burst-pagers; single-thread slack doc
